scripts.text:
[Towner]
I love cacti. They're
the most beautiful plants
in the desert. Sometimes,
they're the only signs of
life in a barren land.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我爱仙人掌。它们是沙漠中
最美丽的植物。有时候，
它们是这片荒凉土地上
唯一的生命迹象。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you feel a stirring
in your heart when you
look at a cactus, you
must appreciate the
desert's true beauty.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你在看到仙人掌时
内心感到一阵悸动，
那你一定懂得欣赏
沙漠真正的美。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I don't know if
I can find anyone that
finds the desert as
wonderful and enchanting
as I do. It's a pity, really.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
唉，我不知道是否能找到
像我一样觉得沙漠如此
奇妙且迷人的人。真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Welcome to Veins, the
town near the Temple of
Cheshrumnir. You may think
this is a dreary desert town,
but you'll find that it's as
lively as any other place.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
欢迎来到伯仁斯，这是
靠近瑟斯隆尼勒神庙的
城镇。你可能觉得这是一个
沉闷的沙漠小镇，但你会发现
这里和其他地方一样热闹。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sure, there are a few
characters in town, like
that cactus loving loony
over there, but not everyone's
like him. There's lots of nice,
kind people that you can meet.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
当然，镇上确实有几个
怪人，比如那边那个
痴迷仙人掌的疯子，但不是
每个人都像他那样。你会遇到
很多友善且善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well then, I hope that
you enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那么，希望你在这里
过得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Geez, why is our weapon
shop so boring? Nothing
there but the same ol'
regular junk. Sad to say,
there's nothing special.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天哪，为什么我们的
武器店这么无聊？那里除了
一堆陈旧的破烂什么都没有。
真遗憾，没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Wouldn't it be great
if there was a shop that
sold the legendary godly
weapons? Of course, that's
asking a bit too much.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果有一家店出售传说中的
神兵利器，那该多好啊？
当然，这要求确实有点太高了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Though we're in the
middle of the desert,
our enemies continue
to threaten us. Fools!
Goddess Freya will
always protect us!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
虽然我们身处沙漠腹地，
但敌人依然在威胁着我们。
蠢货！芙蕾雅女神
会永远守护我们的！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So long as we continue to
train, Freya will watch over
us and bless us with victory
over our foes. That, friend,
is the power of faith.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
只要我们坚持训练，
芙蕾雅就会注视着我们，
并赐予我们战胜敌人的胜利。
朋友，这就是信仰的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Whoa, get out of here!
Can't you see that I'm
playing hide and go seek?!
Move before they find me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，快离开这里！
你没看到我在玩捉迷藏吗？！
快走，别等他们发现我！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Gosh, where could she
be hiding? I hate being
it... There's so many places
to hide around here. There
must be someplace I haven't
checked yet... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
天哪，她会躲在哪里呢？
我讨厌当躲藏者……这附近
有好多地方可以躲。肯定还有
我没检查过的地方……让我看看……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya
for blessing me with
long life, but I wonder
if I've fully lived life.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感谢芙蕾雅赐予我长寿，
但我不知道自己是否真正
充实地活过。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't have any regrets
or doubts, but maybe there
are a few things I missed
out on. I guess an old man
can't help but think about
these sorts of things...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我没有什么遗憾或怀疑，
但也许我错过了一些事情。
我想，老人难免会思考
这些事情吧……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Cacti are wonderful,
they're the most beautiful
plants in the desert. Yes, we
must cherish and nurture them~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
仙人掌很奇妙，它们是
沙漠中最美丽的植物。
是的，我们必须珍惜并
悉心呵护它们~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Regular cacti are 
pretty uncommon, but
I hear there's a kind of
cactus that roams the desert
and makes loud, obnoxious
noises. How can that be true?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
普通的仙人掌并不常见，
但我听说有一种仙人掌
会在沙漠中游荡，并发出
巨大且刺耳的噪音。这怎么可能呢？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do you want?
Sorry, but I'm just
a normal guy with normal
problems. Nothing that
I can't solve on my own.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你想干什么？
抱歉，我只是个有着普通
烦恼的普通人。没什么是我
无法靠自己解决的。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Unless... You can do my
taxes? Pay off my mortgage?
No? Heh. Didn't think so.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
除非……你能帮我报税？
或者帮我还清房贷？
不行吗？呵，我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What's an adventurer
doing here in such an
isolated, dreary town?
Shouldn't you be looking
for adventures? Take it from
me, this place if bo-ring.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
一名冒险者来到这个
偏僻、沉闷的小镇做什么？
你不应该去寻找冒险吗？
听我的，这地方无聊透了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Whoa, it's been a while
seen I've seen tourists
in town. You might think
there's nothing here, but
take a closer look. You
might learn something.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
哇，好久没在镇上
见到游客了。你可能觉得
这里一无所有，但请仔细看看，
你或许能学到些什么。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Just like people, you
can't know everything about
a place with only a glance.
If you give it a chance, I'm
sure you'll find something
to like about this town.
and try to find things that mind interest you?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
就像人一样，你无法仅凭一眼就了解一个地方的一切。如果你愿意给它一个机会，我相信你会发现这个小镇值得喜爱的地方，并试着去寻找让你感兴趣的事物。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do I mean by ''a
closer look?'' Heh, you'll
see... Maybe. Hahahaha!
Oh, forget it, it's not
that important anyway.
May Freya bless you~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我说的“近距离观察”是什么意思？嘿，你会明白的……也许吧。哈哈哈！噢，算了，反正这并不重要。愿芙蕾雅保佑你~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I really want to look
inside the temple, but
it looks so scary from
the outside! I wonder
why it's like that?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我真的很想看看神庙内部，但从外面看它好吓人啊！我想知道为什么会那样？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't get me wrong:
I'd give my life in Freya's
name, but that so-called
temple just looks so strange
and suspicious. How can it
be a place of worship?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
别误会：我愿意以芙蕾雅之名献出生命，但那个所谓的神庙看起来实在太奇怪、太可疑了。它怎么能是一个礼拜的地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I guess you can tell
from this withered tree
that our town is short
on water. I guess that's
a natural consequence of
living here in the desert...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我想从这棵枯树就能看出，我们小镇很缺水。我想这是生活在沙漠中的必然结果吧……

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
When I look down on
Veins from here, I've
come to realize many things.
I don't think you'd understand
no matter how much I explained.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
当我从这里俯瞰伯仁斯时，我领悟到了很多事情。我想无论我如何解释，你都不会理解的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I suppose it's one of those
things that you learn with age.
Yes, there's no substitute for
experience when it comes to
some things. You'll see.
^FFFFFFYes, like secret knowledge.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我想这是那种随着年龄增长才会明白的事情。是的，在某些事情上，经验是无可替代的。你会明白的。^FFFFFF是的，就像那些秘辛知识一样。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
This isn't good.
The elderly outnumber
the youth here in Veins.
We're too close to becoming
something of a retirement
community. You see it, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这可不太好。在伯仁斯，老人比年轻人还要多。我们快要变成养老社区了。你也看出来了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I guess the young people
aren't content living here
since we lack a lot of the
material excitement of other
towns. They can't appreciate
what's really special here...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想年轻人并不满足于住在这里，因为我们缺乏其他城镇那种物质上的刺激。他们无法体会这里真正特别的地方……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
People cherish water
around here, but I've
something even more
precious to me. Yes, even
more precious than water...
You guessed it--true love.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这里的人都非常珍视水，但我有比这更珍贵的东西。是的，甚至比水还要珍贵……你猜对了——真爱。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
We actually started dating
here, so this place really
means a lot to me. It's my
favorite spot for spending
time with my girl. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们其实是在这里开始约会的，所以这个地方对我来说意义重大。这是我陪女朋友度过时光的最爱之地。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I'm actually
a little tired of coming
here all the time. I kind
of want to try someplace
else, but I also know he
really loves coming here.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，其实我也有点厌倦一直来这里了。我有点想尝试别的地方，但我同时也知道他非常喜欢来这里。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It would actually be
kind of sad if we stopped
coming here altogether.
I'm just happy so long
as he's with me~ Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果我们完全不再来这里，那其实会挺伤感的。只要他陪在我身边，我就很开心了~呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why don't you take
a look at my goods?
I've got many things
that might interest you~
scripts.translation:
[老人]
要不要来看看我的货物？我有很多你可能会感兴趣的东西~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya,
who watches over us,
and blesses us with
food and drink. Don't
you think that's great,
young adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
赞美芙蕾雅，她守护着我们，并赐予我们食物和饮水。年轻的冒险家，你不觉得这很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Owning a lot of stuff
might seem great, but
many things aren't that
valuable when you think
of them in terms of
real emotional value.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
拥有很多东西看起来很棒，但当你从情感价值的角度去思考时，很多东西其实并没有那么值钱。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, that might have been
a dangerous remark when
I'm trying to sell things to
customers. Still, I wish
I could carry a wider
selection of goods.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哎呀，在试图向顾客推销东西时，这番话可能有点危险。不过，我还是希望我能携带更多种类的货物。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Of course, we're here
in the middle of the desert,
so maybe I'm asking too much.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
当然，我们身处沙漠中心，所以也许我的要求太高了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! Do you think
I can reach the bridge
over there if I jump
from over here? Do
you think you can try it?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！你觉得如果我从这里跳过去，能跳到那边的桥上吗？你觉得你能试一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
What?! You can't do it?
Well, I'm gonna be different
when I grow up! I'm gonna
be the world's best jumper!
I'm gonna be able to jump
all the way to the mooooon!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
什么？！你做不到吗？哼，我长大后会变得不一样的！我要成为世界上最厉害的跳跃者！我要能一直跳到月亮上去！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The clothes we make here
are high, airy, and sewn
with high quality fabric.
Of course, we need to wear
stuff like this since the
weather is unbearably hot.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们在这里制作的衣服
轻盈透气，且使用了
高品质的面料。
当然，既然天气热得
让人受不了，我们必须
穿这种衣服才行。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The fabric? Well,
I'll give you a hint.
It's made of something
related to camels. Heh!
I'll leave you to figure it
out on your own. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
面料？好吧，
我给你个提示。
是用某种和骆驼
有关的东西做的。嘿！
你自己去琢磨吧。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Let me tell you a secret.
But promise not to tell
anyone else about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
让我告诉你一个秘密。
但你要保证不告诉
其他人，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
When the time comes,
the Temple of Cheshrumnir
will open up and the giant
Freya robot will launch!
It'll destroy every country
except Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
到时候，
瑟斯隆尼勒神庙将会开启，
巨大的芙蕾雅机器人也将启动！
除了阿鲁纳菲兹以外，
它会摧毁所有的国家！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
That robot can blow
hurricanes from its mouth,
and shoot lightning from
its horns, and it can fire
its fists away, and its
chest is a flame thrower!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那个机器人能从嘴里
喷出飓风，从角上
射出闪电，还能把拳头
发射出去，胸口更是
一个火焰喷射器！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
..............................
You don't believe me, either.
What did you just say? Zinger?
Amazing Z? The hell's that?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
..............................
你也不相信我啊。
你刚才说什么？Zinger？
Amazing Z？那是什么鬼东西？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Argh! I'm a war god
protecting Goddess Freya
and Arunafeltz! Ahhhhh!
Death to all our enemies!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊！我是守护着
芙蕾雅女神和
阿鲁纳菲兹的战神！啊啊啊啊！
让所有的敌人死掉吧！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Burn, heretics, buuurn!
Destroy your homes, your
families, and build a new
perfect world for Freya!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
烧起来吧，异教徒，烧起来！
摧毁你们的家园、你们的
家庭，为芙蕾雅建立一个
全新的完美世界！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hee hee! Doesn't that
sound wonderful! When
I grow up, I wanna be
that kind of hero!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘻嘻！听起来是不是
很棒！等我长大了，
我也想成为那样的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Fr... Fr...

[Old Man]
Fr...

[Old Man]
Praise Freya! ^333333*Keck*^000000
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 Fre...
^333333*Cough*^000000 Praise Freya!
Freya! Conquer those
that blaspheme you! Let
me see it before I die!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
赞美芙蕾雅！ ^333333*咳*^000000
^333333*咳咳*^000000 芙...
^333333*咳*^000000 赞美芙蕾雅！
芙蕾雅！去征服那些
亵渎您的人吧！让我
在死前亲眼见证这一切！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I have never regretted
^333333*Cough*^000000 my faith in you,
my goddess! ^333333*Keck*^000000 May
the suffering of all our
enemies drive them to
madness before death!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我从未后悔过
^333333*咳*^000000 对您的信仰，
我的女神！ ^333333*咳*^000000 愿我们所有
敌人的痛苦能让他们在
死前陷入疯狂！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I wonder what my
standing with Freya
is like. Hopefully, she
will take mercy upon me
when I leave this world.
My days here are numbered...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我在想，我与芙蕾雅
的关系如何。希望当我
离开这个世界时，她能
对我仁慈一些。
我在这里的日子不多了...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh? You don't live here.
Are you... Are you a traveler?
You musta been to so many
other places, huh? What
do they look like? I want to
travel too when I grow up~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯？你不住在这里。
你是... 你是旅人吗？
你一定去过很多
其他地方吧，对吗？
那里是什么样子的？我长大了
也想去旅行~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I like this town, but I want
to see how other people live.
The grown-ups think it's a bad
idea, though. They say Freya
hates it. Is it that bad that
I can't stop wondering?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我喜欢这个小镇，但我想
看看其他人的生活方式。
不过大人们觉得那是
个坏主意。他们说芙蕾雅
很讨厌那样。难道真的有
那么糟糕，让我忍不住好奇吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh. You must be
sightseeing. Um,
Veins is a small town,
visit Cheshrumnir Temple?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
噢。你一定是来
观光的。嗯，
伯仁斯是个小镇，
要去参观瑟斯隆尼勒神庙吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I hope you enjoy
your stay. Now if
you'll excuse me, I'd
like to continue with
my prayers to Freya.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
希望你在这里
过得愉快。现在如果
失礼的话，我想
继续向芙蕾雅
祈祷了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, gracious Freya, your
servant humbly beseeches
you on bended knee...
Heal me of this infirmity!
The body is droopingly limp,
but the spirit is willing...!
must be... Cheshrumnir Temple.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
噢，仁慈的芙蕾雅，您的
仆人正谦卑地跪在您面前
恳求您...
治愈我的病痛！
身体虽然虚弱无力，
但精神依然坚定...！
一定是... 瑟斯隆尼勒神庙。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
You know what's good
about the desert? No?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你知道沙漠里
有什么好的吗？不知道？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The desert makes you
stronger. Understand
what I mean? Heh, you'll
know as you spend more
time here in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠会让你变得更强大。
明白我的意思吗？呵呵，你在沙漠里
待的时间越长，就会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
Unbelievable!
What kind of country
is this?! How can you
lock me up just because
I don't believe in Freya?!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
简直难以置信！
这到底是个什么样的国家？！
就因为我不信仰芙蕾雅，
你们就把我关起来？！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
This isn't civilized!
You're a bunch of savages
if you can't respect my
beliefs, you know that?
Someone, someone help!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
这简直不文明！
如果你们连我的信仰都不尊重，
那你们就是一群野蛮人，知道吗？
救命，谁来救救我！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
This place ensures that
dangerous criminals aren't
threatening the publi--
Wait. Why are you even
here?! This place isn't
safe for you! Leave!
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
这里是为了确保危险的罪犯
不会威胁到公众——
等等。你怎么会在这里？！
这里对你来说并不安全！快离开！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
I'm grateful that our
town is relatively peaceful.
If it were any other place,
that tiny cell would be
crammed full of criminals.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
我很庆幸我们的城镇还算太平。
如果是其他地方，那间小小的牢房里
早就挤满了罪犯了。

scripts.text:
[Ward]
Thank Freya that I've
been assigned to such
a peaceful, quiet place.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
感谢芙蕾雅，让我被分配到这样一个
和平且安静的地方。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
I must study as hard as I can
for the grace of Goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
^333333*喘气 喘气*^000000
为了感谢芙蕾雅女神的恩典，
我必须竭尽全力学习。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really believe that
I can serve Freya one of
these days if I can just
expand my knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我坚信，只要我能不断增长见识，
总有一天能为芙蕾雅效力。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It's too hot...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太热了……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So sweaty...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
汗流浃背……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Tricked you!
Thought I was dead,
didn't you? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
骗你的！
你以为我死了，对吧？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The drinks in this
town are so... They're...
They're so damn strong!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个镇子里的酒真是……它们……
它们也太烈了！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Why...
Why does the ground
keep wobbling?! It's...
It's like it's trying to
betray me! Every time!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
为什么……
为什么地面一直晃个不停？！
就像它在试图背叛我一样！每次都这样！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000

[Towner]
It's nice when a town
is peaceful and quiet...
But it's lame when a
tavern is dead like this.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
城镇太平安静固然是好事……
但酒馆像这样冷冷清清的也挺没劲的。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, there's good
and bad points to
everything. Hopefully
things will pick up
around here as more of
you adventurers come visit.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，凡事都有好坏两面。
希望随着更多冒险者的到来，
这里的生意能好转起来。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
There's nothing but
old people and children
in this town. Where's a
decent man worth marrying?
There's a few bachelors that
are my age, but... Well...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个镇子里除了老人就是小孩。
哪里有值得嫁的好男人呢？
虽然有几个和我年纪相仿的单身汉，但是……唉……

scripts.text:
[Towner]
They're all too hairy or
too muscular. I don't think
I'll be able to get married
anytime soon! Oh, the misery!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
他们不是毛发太重就是肌肉太壮。
我觉得我短期内是没法结婚了！噢，真是痛苦！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, our town doesn't
have a choice but to
defend itself in dangerous
times. The young men we
have here are all buff and
tough to protect us.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
唉，在危险时期，我们的城镇
除了自卫别无选择。我们这里的年轻人
都很强壮，足以保护我们。

scripts.text:
[Town]
They may not be beautiful,
but they have kind and
gentle hearts. It's a pity
that the women here
are more concerned
with appearances.
scripts.translation:
[城镇]
他们或许并不美观，
但拥有一颗善良且
温柔的心。可惜这里的
女性更在意
外表。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't judge a book
by its cover, but
by its contents.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
不要以貌取人，
要看其内在。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
This storage solely
exists for serious drinkers.
If it's ever shut down,
I think everyone in town
will riot. Crazy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个酒窖纯粹是
为嗜酒者准备的。
如果它被关闭了，
我想镇上的所有人
都会暴动。很疯狂，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Veins is famous for its
wide variety of delicious,
irresistible liquor. Just one
sip's enough to hook you.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
伯仁斯以其种类繁多、
美味且令人无法抗拒的
美酒而闻名。只需
抿上一口就足以让你着迷。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Praise Freya for
blessing us with the
gift of awesome liquor.
Her graciousness, her
compassion, her liquor
is limitless. Let us pray.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
赞美芙蕾雅，
赐予我们如此美酒的
恩赐。她的仁慈、
她的怜悯、她的美酒
无穷无尽。让我们祈祷吧。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really want to
ask out the woman
right in front of me.
Do you think she'll...?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我真的很想
约面前的那个
女人出去。你觉得她会...？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Crap! Did I say that
out loud? I-I-I really
didn't want her to hear!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
糟了！我把那话
说出声了吗？我-我-我
真的不想让她听到！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I heard all that...
Gosh, he's so clueless.
I don't hate him, but he
should show a bit more
backbone if he wants
to impress me. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我全听到了...
天呐，他真是个木头。
我不讨厌他，但如果他
想给我留下好印象，
就应该表现得更有
骨气一点。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you enjoy a good,
stiff drink, then you have
to stop by Veins Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你喜欢烈酒，
那就一定要来
伯仁斯酒馆看看~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you don't love
drinking, then Veins
Tavern is the perfect
place to learn! ...To
love... drinking...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你不爱
喝酒，那么伯仁斯
酒馆就是学习的
完美场所！...爱...上...
喝酒...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Isn't the sun so hot?
Doesn't it make you feel
so thirsty? Well, you may
want to consider quenching
that nasty thirst with liquor!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太阳不是很热吗？
不会让你觉得
很渴吗？好吧，你或许
可以考虑用美酒来
解解这难受的渴！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
My job is to serve
delicious, life giving
liquor to my customers to
relieve their parched throats.
Seeing their drunken smiles
really makes my day~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我的工作就是为顾客
提供美味、能赋予生命
的美酒，以缓解他们
干渴的喉咙。
看到他们醉酒后的笑容，
真的让我心情大好~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
A lone wolf of the desert.
That's me. Well, that's why
I'm drinking here alone.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠中的独狼。
那就是我。好吧，这就是
为什么我一个人在这里喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sweet Freya, these
drinks are so good.
I could drink all day.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
亲爱的芙蕾雅，这些
酒真的太棒了。
我能喝上一整天。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Man, the world is just...
It's just desires...!
Faith? It helps, you
know? Cuz-cuz desires
are all just nothing!
They're nooooooothing!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天呐，这个世界就是...
就是欲望...！
信仰？它很有用，你
知道吗？因为-因为欲望
全都是虚无！
它们全都是虚无وووووو！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Argh! What is life?!
I don't know what to
believe anymore! Freya!
Freya looooves you!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
啊！人生是什么？！
我不知道该相信
什么了！芙蕾雅！
芙蕾雅爱你哦！
